title: Channels
body: Every screen shows a channel. Channel names are unique on the server, and each belongs to the player who made it.
Your own channels are always yours to use. Someone else's needs its password once: after that you can show it on your projectors until the owner changes the password.
The owner can change the password, move the camera to another terminal, or delete the channel. Passwords are stored hashed, and too many wrong guesses lock you out for a minute.
Server owners can set how many channels a player may own in config/generallaymansaestheticspyingscreen.json.
